Name: Valley Girls - Disable Abigail Sam Sebastian Saloon and Haley Alex Beach Events
Author: TNTpocket
Description:
Description

This Content Patcher add-on disables two sets of fixed group events from Valley Girls:

• Abigail, Sam, and Sebastian events in the Saloon
• Haley and Alex events at the Beach

Only those specific events are removed. All other Valley Girls content remains unchanged, including individual NPC events, schedules, animations, dialogue, mail, translations, and other features.

This mod is also compatible with Harem Valley. Harem Valley events, including its independent Abigail events, are not modified.


Installation

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Install Valley Girls.
4. Download this mod and extract the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.

When installed correctly, the structure should look similar to:

Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── Valley Girls - Disable Abigail Sam Sebastian Saloon and Haley Alex Beach Events/
        └── [CP] Valley Girls - Disable Abigail Sam Sebastian Saloon and Haley Alex Beach Events/

Vortex installation is also supported.

To uninstall, simply remove this mod's folder. The original Valley Girls files are not modified.


Main features

• Disables the Abigail, Sam, and Sebastian Saloon event chain
• Disables the Haley and Alex Beach event chain
• Leaves all other Valley Girls content unchanged
• Compatible with Harem Valley
• Does not overwrite or edit the original Valley Girls files
• Can be safely removed at any time
• Includes separate configuration options for the Saloon and Beach events
• Supports Generic Mod Config Menu for easier configuration


Configuration

The following options are enabled by default:

DisableSaloonEvent
Disables the Abigail, Sam, and Sebastian Saloon events.

DisableBeachEvent
Disables the Haley and Alex Beach events.

The settings can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu, or by editing config.json manually.


Requirements

Required:
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Valley Girls

Optional:
• Generic Mod Config Menu
• Harem Valley

Harem Valley is not required. This mod works with Valley Girls both with and without Harem Valley installed.


Compatibility

This mod removes only the following Valley Girls event entries:

Saloon:
10535, 10537, 10539, 10541

Beach:
10536, 10538, 10540, 10542

It does not disable Sex Schedules, Robin and Demetrius content, HVAbigail events, individual character events, animations, translations, or other Valley Girls and Harem Valley features.


Shout outs

Thanks to Trashracc1124 for creating Valley Girls, and to the developers of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
